visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue denim-style jumpsuit, stands in an outdoor area at night. She smiles broadly, revealing white teeth, and gestures with her hands towards her face before pointing to a large, black, truss-style Dobsonian telescope positioned behind her. The background is dark, showing a parking lot surface and some faint outlines of equipment or buildings under artificial lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a high-magnification view of the moon's surface, captured through the telescope. The lunar landscape is visible in sharp detail, showing numerous craters and textured plains. A red circular highlight and an arrow appear on the screen to indicate a specific flat area on the moon. (3) The camera pans slowly across the lunar surface, revealing the dense cratering in the northern hemisphere. A white highlight appears over a linear mountain range. The lighting on the moon creates deep shadows within the craters, emphasizing the rugged topography. The woman's face is no longer visible, as the focus remains on the telescope's output.
